articles.abstract_en: We develop a Bayesian method for estimating the dynamics of COVID‐19 deaths and discover four key findings that expose the limitations of current structural epidemiological models . (i) Death growth rates declined rapidly from high levels during the initial 30 days of the epidemic worldwide. (ii) After this initial period, these rates fluctuated substantially around 0%. (iii) The cross‐location standard deviation of death growth rates decreased rapidly in the first 10 days but remained high afterward. (iv) These insights apply to both effective reproduction numbers and their cross‐location variability through epidemiological models. Our method is applicable to studying other epidemics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种贝叶斯方法来估计COVID-19死亡动态，并发现了四个关键发现，这些发现揭示了当前结构流行病学模型的局限性。(i) 在世界范围内疫情最初的30天内，死亡率增长率从高水平迅速下降。(ii) 在这一初始阶段之后，这些比率在0%左右大幅波动。(iii) 死亡率增长率的跨地区标准差在最初10天内迅速下降，但之后仍保持较高水平。(iv) 这些见解通过流行病学模型适用于有效再生数及其跨地区变异性。我们的方法也适用于研究其他流行病。

articles.title_en: Government Expenditure on the Public Education System
articles.title_cn: 公共教育体系中的政府支出
articles.abstract_en: We investigate equilibrium impacts of federal policies such as free‐college proposals, taking into account that human capital is cumulative and that state governments have resource constraints. In our model, a state government cares about household welfare and aggregate educational attainment. The government chooses income tax rates, per‐student expenditures on K‐12 and college education, college tuition, and the provision of other public goods. We estimate the model using U.S. data. Our simulations suggest that free‐college policies would decrease state expenditure on education. More students would obtain college degrees. Most households would “pay” for the free‐college policies through negative welfare effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了联邦政策（如免费大学提案）的均衡影响，同时考虑到人力资本具有累积性且州政府面临资源约束。在我们的模型中，州政府关心家庭福利和总体教育成就。政府选择所得税税率、K-12和大学教育的生均支出、大学学费以及其他公共品的提供。我们使用美国数据估计该模型。我们的模拟表明，免费大学政策将减少州教育支出。更多学生将获得大学学位。大多数家庭将通过负面的福利效应来“支付”免费大学政策。

articles.title_en: Capital Tax Reforms With Policy Uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 政策不确定性下的资本税改革
articles.abstract_en: One important feature of capital tax reforms is the uncertainty regarding their duration. In a standard heterogeneous firm framework with financial frictions, we model policy uncertainty by assuming that reforms may be either repealed or maintained with some probability every period. We illustrate the effects of policy uncertainty in the context of the 2003 Bush tax cuts (2003 Job Growth Tax Relief Reconciliation Act), which lowered shareholder taxes. We show that policy uncertainty regarding dividend and capital gains taxes can explain why the Bush tax cuts had no statistically significant effect on investment, in line with the empirical evidence.
articles.abstract_cn: 资本税改革的一个重要特征是其持续时间的不确定性。在一个具有金融摩擦的标准异质性企业框架中，我们通过假设改革每期可能被废除或维持一定概率来模拟政策不确定性。我们以2003年布什减税（2003年就业增长税收减免协调法案）为背景说明政策不确定性的影响，该法案降低了股东税。我们表明，关于股息税和资本利得税的政策不确定性可以解释为什么布什减税对投资没有统计上显著的影响，这与实证证据一致。

articles.title_en: Consumption Tax Cuts In A Recession
articles.abstract_en: I study the effectiveness of temporary cuts to consumption tax rates as fiscal stimulus instruments during recessions using a structural life‐cycle model with multiple consumption categories. I find tax elasticities of 0.4 for nondurable luxuries and of 10.5 for durables. I show that the tax cut on nondurables has an intratemporal substitution effect, whereas the tax cut on durables acts through an intertemporal substitution mechanism that is stronger for high‐income, liquidity‐unconstrained, and younger households. This mechanism is amplified in less persistent recessions and dampened in absence of recessions due to durables' partial irreversibility and precautionary saving motives.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究在经济衰退期间，作为财政刺激工具的临时性消费税税率削减的有效性，使用一个包含多种消费类别的结构性生命周期模型。我发现非耐用品奢侈品的税收弹性为0.4，耐用品的税收弹性为10.5。我表明，对非耐用品的减税具有期内替代效应，而对耐用品的减税则通过跨期替代机制发挥作用，该机制对高收入、无流动性约束和较年轻家庭更为强烈。这种机制在不太持久的衰退中被放大，而在没有衰退的情况下，由于耐用品的部分不可逆性和预防性储蓄动机而被削弱。

articles.title_en: Tutoring Efficacy, Household Substitution, And Student Achievement: Experimental Evidence From An After‐School Tutoring Program In Rural China
articles.title_cn: 辅导效果、家庭替代与学生成绩：来自中国农村课后辅导项目的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: After‐school tutoring has risen globally despite limited evidence of effectiveness. We implement a randomized after‐school tutoring program in rural China where many children are left‐behind by parents in care of grandparents. Compared to tutees cared for by parents, those in care of grandparents reported much smaller home‐tutoring reductions but larger test‐score gains. We interpret our data analysis with a model with tutoring efficacy and substitution between private and public inputs both differing by family background: Increased public tutoring generates larger test‐score gains for children who experience greater tutoring efficacy and lesser substitution with household inputs, consistent with our estimates.
articles.abstract_cn: 课后辅导在全球范围内兴起，尽管其有效性的证据有限。我们在中国农村实施了一项随机课后辅导项目，那里许多儿童被父母留守，由祖父母照顾。与由父母照顾的受辅导儿童相比，由祖父母照顾的儿童报告的家庭辅导减少幅度小得多，但考试成绩提升更大。我们通过一个模型来解释我们的数据分析，该模型包含辅导效果以及私人投入与公共投入之间的替代，两者均因家庭背景而异：增加的公共辅导为那些体验到更大辅导效果且与家庭投入替代较少的儿童带来更大的考试成绩提升，这与我们的估计一致。

articles.title_en: Labor Supply In The Extended Household: Economies Of Scale, Self‐Selection, And The Intrahousehold Distribution Of Resources In South Africa
articles.title_cn: 扩展家庭中的劳动力供给：规模经济、自我选择与南非家庭内部资源分配
articles.abstract_en: This article studies labor supply in the extended household (composed of two families living together). The extended household structure affects the incentives to work of household members for at least three reasons: economies of scale, cash transfers between the families living in the extended household, and easier childcare arrangements. We develop a structural model incorporating these components and taking into account the self‐selection process into extended households. We then estimate this model with South African data and provide an explanation for the differences in participation rates between nuclear and extended households.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了扩展家庭（由两个家庭共同居住组成）中的劳动力供给。扩展家庭结构通过至少三个原因影响家庭成员的工作激励：规模经济、扩展家庭中共同居住家庭之间的现金转移，以及更便利的儿童照护安排。我们开发了一个包含这些组成部分并考虑进入扩展家庭的自我选择过程的结构模型。然后，我们使用南非数据估计该模型，并为核家庭与扩展家庭之间参与率的差异提供解释。

articles.title_en: Household Inventory, Temporary Sales, Price Indices
articles.title_cn: 家庭库存、临时销售与价格指数
articles.abstract_en: This study addresses the large bias in chained price indices that persists even at lower frequencies. The bias arises from intertemporal substitution caused by consumer hoarding, and is problematic for purchase‐based data. In order to resolve this issue, we propose a method for calculating changes in inventories and consumption using retailer scanner data. We construct a partial equilibrium model to estimate inventories and consumption and show that the model accurately predicts the sign and size of the bias. We also demonstrate that the bias is smaller for consumption‐based data and propose a particular type of price index that eliminates intertemporal substitution bias.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究解决了链式价格指数即使在较低频率下仍存在的较大偏差问题。该偏差源于消费者囤积引起的跨期替代，并且对基于购买的数据而言是有问题的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种使用零售商扫描数据计算库存和消费变化的方法。我们构建了一个部分均衡模型来估计库存和消费，并表明该模型能准确预测偏差的符号和大小。我们还证明了基于消费的数据偏差较小，并提出了一种特定类型的价格指数，以消除跨期替代偏差。

articles.title_en: Business Cycles With Cyclical Returns To Scale
articles.title_cn: 具有周期性规模收益的经济周期
articles.abstract_en: We study business cycles with cyclical returns to scale. Contrary to tightly parameterized conventional production functions, we empirically identify strong input complementarity that leads to procyclical returns to scale. We, therefore, propose a flexible translog production function that allows complementarity‐induced procyclical returns to scale. We integrate this function into a standard medium‐scale dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model. Our estimated model with input complementarity (i) features procyclical returns to scale and acyclical price markups, (ii) better matches the cyclicality of factor shares, and (iii) significantly decreases the contribution of markup shocks to output fluctuations relative to those of the standard model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有周期性规模收益的经济周期。与参数化严格设定的传统生产函数相反，我们通过实证识别出强烈的投入互补性，这导致了顺周期的规模收益。因此，我们提出了一种灵活的超越对数生产函数，允许由互补性引起的顺周期规模收益。我们将此函数整合到一个标准的中等规模动态随机一般均衡模型中。我们估计的具有投入互补性的模型（i）具有顺周期的规模收益和非周期的价格加成，（ii）更好地匹配要素份额的周期性，并且（iii）相对于标准模型，显著降低了加成冲击对产出波动的贡献。

articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of the discovery of precious metals in America from 1500 to 1810 on international trade. Around 1500, there was a simultaneous discovery of precious metals and new trading routes. We construct a counterfactual of new routes but no precious metals. The discovery of precious metals increased the stock of precious metals more than 10‐fold. We show that Euro‐Asian trade at its peak increased up to 20 times compared with the counterfactual. Our simulations match the observed price dynamics. We find that precious metals were at least as important as the new routes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了1500年至1810年间美洲贵金属的发现对国际贸易的影响。大约在1500年，贵金属的发现与新贸易路线同时出现。我们构建了一个有新路线但无贵金属的反事实情景。贵金属的发现使贵金属存量增加了超过10倍。我们表明，与反事实情景相比，欧亚贸易在高峰期增长了多达20倍。我们的模拟与观察到的价格动态相匹配。我们发现贵金属至少与新路线同等重要。

articles.title_en: College Expansion, Trade, And Innovation: Evidence From China
articles.title_cn: 大学扩招、贸易与创新：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: China has expanded the yearly quota on newly admitted college students by more than seven times since 1999. How did this massive education expansion affect firms' export and innovation choices? I document that after this expansion impacted the labor market, manufacturing firms' innovation increased considerably, especially among exporting firms, accompanied by sizable skill upgrading of exports. I then develop a multi‐industry spatial equilibrium model, featuring skill intensity differences across industries and heterogeneous firms' innovation and export choices. Quantitatively, the college expansion explained 72% of increases in China's manufacturing research and development (R&D) intensity between 2003 and 2018 and also triggered export skill upgrading.
articles.abstract_cn: 自1999年以来，中国每年新增大学生配额扩大了七倍以上。这一大规模教育扩张如何影响企业的出口和创新选择？我记录了在这次扩张影响劳动力市场后，制造业企业的创新显著增加，尤其是在出口企业中，同时伴随着出口技能的显著升级。随后，我构建了一个多行业空间均衡模型，该模型具有跨行业的技能强度差异以及异质性企业的创新和出口选择。定量分析显示，大学扩招解释了2003年至2018年间中国制造业研发强度增长的72%，并引发了出口技能升级。

articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of unilateral economic disintegration, such as Brexit, on national and international policies. We introduce firm mobility and business‐tax policies into a general‐equilibrium trade model and analyze the effects of disintegration on tax policies of asymmetric countries. Although the disintegrating country taxes less, business taxes converge in the remaining economic area. We highlight important differences with existing two‐country models. Moreover, we predict a realignment of trade policies with a deeper integration inside the union and lower tariffs worldwide. The leaving country's endogenous integration response with other countries may fully compensate for the disintegration‐induced welfare losses.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了单边经济解体（如英国脱欧）对国家和国际政策的影响。我们将企业流动性和商业税收政策引入一般均衡贸易模型，并分析解体对不对称国家税收政策的影响。尽管解体国家的税收较低，但剩余经济区的商业税收趋于收敛。我们强调了与现有两国模型的重要差异。此外，我们预测贸易政策将重新调整，联盟内部一体化加深，全球关税降低。离开国家与其他国家的内生一体化反应可能完全补偿解体引起的福利损失。

articles.title_en: Generational Distribution of Fiscal Burdens: A Positive Analysis
articles.title_cn: 财政负担的代际分布：一项实证分析
articles.abstract_en: This study presents an overlapping generations model to analyze the impact of population aging on fiscal policy and intergenerational fiscal burden. Aging populations incentivize governments to increase capital and labor income tax rates and the public debt‐to‐GDP ratio, consistent with OECD evidence. Our model‐based simulation for Japan and the United States (2000–2070) reveals that Japan will experience higher labor income tax rates, a greater public debt‐to‐GDP ratio, and a lower government expenditure‐to‐GDP ratio compared to the United States. From 2040 onward, Japan is predicted to surpass the United States in terms of the capital tax rate.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一个世代交叠模型，以分析人口老龄化对财政政策和代际财政负担的影响。老龄化人口激励政府提高资本和劳动所得税率以及公共债务与GDP之比，这与OECD的证据一致。我们基于模型对日本和美国（2000-2070年）的模拟显示，与美国相比，日本将经历更高的劳动所得税率、更大的公共债务与GDP之比以及更低的政府支出与GDP之比。从2040年起，预计日本在资本税率方面将超过美国。

articles.title_cn: 分散市场中的库存管理
articles.abstract_en: We present a directed search model of intermediaries' dynamic inventory and revenue management. Search frictions hinder instantaneous replenishment, prompting intermediaries to utilize dynamic inventory‐based pricing and ordering strategies. In equilibrium, when inventory is high, an intermediary posts a lower retail price to speed up sales and depresses wholesale price to slow down purchases. We characterize the evolution dynamics of inventory holdings and their steady‐state distribution, and extend the model to multiunit wholesale orders, product differentiation, and heterogeneous intermediaries. Using data from used‐car dealers, we quantitatively evaluate the welfare consequence of used‐car dealers' inventory management practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个关于中介机构动态库存和收益管理的定向搜索模型。搜索摩擦阻碍了即时补货，促使中介机构采用基于库存的动态定价和订购策略。在均衡状态下，当库存较高时，中介机构会设定较低的零售价格以加速销售，并压低批发价格以减缓采购。我们刻画了库存持有的动态演变及其稳态分布，并将模型扩展到多单位批发订单、产品差异化和异质性中介机构。利用二手车经销商的数据，我们定量评估了二手车经销商库存管理实践的福利后果。

articles.title_en: Unemployment Duration Under Flexible Information Acquisition
articles.title_cn: 灵活信息获取下的失业持续时间
articles.abstract_en: We consider a worker's job search problem in which firms arrive sequentially, observe the worker's unemployment duration, and conduct an interview to learn about her unobservable productivity. Firms engage in fully flexible information acquisition subject to a uniformly posterior‐separable cost function. We provide a closed‐form characterization of equilibrium job search dynamics and demonstrate that endogenous information amplifies the “stigma” effect of long unemployment duration relative to exogenous information. We also show that lowering firms' information‐acquisition costs has ambiguous implications for a worker's unemployment duration.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个工人的求职问题，其中企业依次到达，观察工人的失业持续时间，并进行面试以了解其不可观测的生产率。企业在服从均匀后验可分成本函数的情况下进行完全灵活的信息获取。我们提供了均衡求职动态的闭式特征，并证明相对于外生信息，内生信息放大了长期失业持续时间的“污名”效应。我们还表明，降低企业的信息获取成本对工人的失业持续时间具有模糊的影响。

articles.title_en: Accounting For Social Security Claiming Behavior
articles.title_cn: 社会保障领取行为核算
articles.abstract_en: We study why Social Security benefit claiming is concentrated at two ages, 62 and the full retirement age, and provide three main findings. First, we show that claiming behavior can be well explained by a parsimonious life‐cycle model with fully rational agents. The two key mechanisms are (i) the strong unwillingness to hold annuities and (ii) the effects of the earnings test. Second, we show that current rules distort claiming and labor supply decisions, and eliminating these distortions results in large welfare gains. Finally, we show that claiming decisions can be used to sharpen the identification of important preference parameters.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究为何社会保障福利领取集中在两个年龄，即62岁和完全退休年龄，并提供三个主要发现。首先，我们表明，领取行为可以通过一个包含完全理性代理人的简约生命周期模型得到很好的解释。两个关键机制是（i）对年金的强烈不愿持有和（ii）收入测试的影响。其次，我们表明，现行规则扭曲了领取和劳动供给决策，消除这些扭曲会带来巨大的福利收益。最后，我们表明，领取决策可用于加强重要偏好参数的识别。

articles.title_en: The Full Recession: Private Versus Social Costs Of Covid‐19
articles.title_cn: 全面衰退：新冠疫情的私人成本与社会成本19
articles.abstract_en: 2020 official recession figures ignore the costs associated with the loss of human life due to COVID‐19. This article constructs full recession measures that consider the death toll. Our model features nonexpected utility, leisure, age‐specific survival rates, and tractable heterogeneity. We find an average full recession of 10.7%, which reflects the net value of an aggregate drop in consumption of 2.7%, an average increase of 197 leisure hours and about 540,000 lives lost in the first pandemic year. The full recession for a utilitarian planner is 14.5%, which aligns with that of individuals in their late 50s.
articles.abstract_cn: 2020官方衰退数据忽略了因新冠病毒而造成的人员伤亡的成本19。本文构建了考虑死亡人数的全面衰退措施。我们的模型具有意想不到的效用、休闲、特定年龄的生存率和易于处理的异质性。我们发现平均全面衰退为10.7%，这反映了消费总下降2.7%的净值、平均增加197休闲时间以及在大流行第一年失去的约540000条生命。功利主义规划者的全面衰退是14.5%，这与晚年的个人的情况一致50。
